description: Everything gathered for a bundle, and everything that could not be.

missing.description:
What could not be collected, named.

Named rather than passed over: a bundle from a machine whose diagnostics will not
run is exactly the bundle worth having, and a gap nobody mentions reads as an
absence of trouble rather than as an absence of information.

pieces.description: The files, in the order a reader would want them.

taken.description: Where and when it came from.

terms.description: How it was made, and what its operator chose.
